title: Random Flip Matrix
goal: Solve Random Flip Matrix: Design a structure to flip random cells in a matrix and reset.
strategy: Design a structure to flip random cells in a matrix and reset.
edgeCases: Sampling must exclude previously flipped cells until reset; reset restores the full available population.
inputRules: m * n must be <= 400 for display
flips must be an array of [row, col] pairs
each flip must be a [row, col] pair of integers
